reason: Letting agents run unwatched all night on our paid logins is exactly how a looping run eats our quota before anyone wakes up. A pre-alpha from one developer does not earn that level of trust, and our laptops are shut overnight anyway.
objection: Nothing in the offer tells me how it stops a runaway or failed run from burning tokens, or caps spend per night. One developer behind it means nobody answers when it breaks at 3am.
would_change_my_mind: Hard per-run and per-night token or cost limits that stop runs automatically, plus a morning report of exactly what each run spent.
